text:
Two cars P and Q have different engines.
The input power from the fuel is the same for both engines. The engine in car P is more efficient
than the engine in car Q.
Which statement about the cars or their engines must be true?
A
Car P has a higher maximum speed than car Q.
B
Car P has a lower maximum speed than car Q.
C
The engine in car P uses less energy per hour than the engine in car Q.
D
The engine in car P wastes less energy per hour than the engine in car Q.

options.label: A
options.text: Car P has a higher maximum speed than car Q.

options.label: B
options.text: Car P has a lower maximum speed than car Q.

options.label: C
options.text: The engine in car P uses less energy per hour than the engine in car Q.

options.label: D
options.text: The engine in car P wastes less energy per hour than the engine in car Q.
